Reliable performance, low maintenance, after-sales support. Authorised partners: Adani | Microtek | Waaree | SBI | Union Bank | Canara Bank. 9052 144 777 | www.solar6.co.in. PAN India Services. ad_library.summary: Solar6 is running an active Telugu Dasara-special ad on Meta (Library ID 1115998414098781, started 14 September 2026) offering zero-down-payment solar with a free Amaron inverter and battery - and the ad sends every click to WhatsApp. The company has over a decade of experience, is headquartered in Kukatpally, and runs both solar6.co.in and solar6.in. The ad's phone number (9052 144 777) is different from the one published on the site (+91 9912355344).

funnel.meaning: The paid click goes straight to a chat. There is no site visit, no email capture, no landing page - so nothing can be measured, tested or retargeted, and a visitor who does not reply is gone.

findings: The live Dasara ad sends every click to WhatsApp - no site visit, no email capture, nothing to measure or retarget.
The ad's phone number (9052 144 777) is different from the number published on the site (+91 9912355344) - two numbers, two funnels, one brand.

The site's 'Success by the Numbers' counters all read 0 - 0+ projects completed, 0+ happy customers, 0+ team members, 0+ years of experience - while the homepage claims 'India's #2 Leading Rooftop Solar Company'.
The site still carries template demo links (wordpress.vecurosoft.com/energiso) and a project image credited to 'Maxwatt Solar' - another company's photo.
Authorised-partner line in the ad (Adani, Microtek, Waaree, SBI, Union Bank, Canara Bank) is strong trust material with no matching proof page for a WhatsApp-click visitor.
next_steps: Build an owned page for the offer
Put the Dasara offer - zero down payment, Rs 78,000 + subsidy, free Amaron inverter and battery - on a landing page on solar6.co.in, and send the ad there.
Name, phone and locality on the page first, WhatsApp second - so non-repliers can be followed up instead of lost.
Fix the counters and the credit
0+ projects and 0+ years read as a startup next to an 'India's #2' claim. Remove the Maxwatt Solar photo credit and fill in real numbers.
The ad says 9052 144 777, the site says +91 9912355344. One number, everywhere, so the paid click and the site agree.
